description: Calendar-year returns by year with the arithmetic mean and compound annual rate over the complete years in the range. The basis depends on the index and is stated in `basis`: sp500 (from 1928) has both price return and total return (dividends reinvested); ndx and sox are index levels, price return only; xlk, xlf, xly and xlp are fund prices adjusted for dividends, total return only. A basis an index does not have is null. The current year is year-to-date and flagged `ytd`.

index.description: Which index or ETF. Default sp500.

name: annual_returns
title: Calendar-year returns
